25. Indemnification

PLEASE READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY. IT AFFECTS YOUR RIGHT TO BRING CLAIMS IN COURT AND TO PARTICIPATE IN CLASS PROCEEDINGS.
28.1 Informal dispute resolution
Before initiating arbitration or litigation, except where an exception below applies, you and Ivy agree to make a good-faith effort to resolve the dispute informally.

28.2 Agreement to arbitrate
Except as expressly provided below, disputes arising out of or relating to these Terms, the Service, or the relationship between you and Ivy will be resolved through individual binding arbitration rather than a court trial.
Arbitration will be administered by the American Arbitration Association ("AAA") under its applicable rules, including its Consumer Arbitration Rules where applicable.
The AAA's rules are available at https://www.adr.org.
The Federal Arbitration Act governs this arbitration agreement where applicable.
The arbitrator may award any individual remedy available under applicable law.
Nothing in this agreement limits legally available remedies that cannot lawfully be restricted.
28.3 Arbitration costs and location

28.4 Exceptions
Either party may bring an eligible individual claim in small claims court.

Nothing in these Terms prevents you from reporting concerns to governmental agencies, regulators, or law enforcement.
Claims that cannot lawfully be subjected to predispute arbitration are excluded from this arbitration requirement.
28.5 Individual proceedings and class-action waiver
TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, YOU AND IVY AGREE THAT DISPUTES SUBJECT TO ARBITRATION WILL BE RESOLVED ON AN INDIVIDUAL BASIS AND NOT AS PART OF A CLASS, COLLECTIVE, OR REPRESENTATIVE PROCEEDING.
